Overview
Two reliable, easy ways to check Shanghai's current weather in Chrome:
- Quick: use Chrome's omnibox (Google search) to see a weather card immediately.
- Detailed: open a weather site (example: AccuWeather) to see a full current-weather card, hourly/daily forecasts and radar.

Method A — Quick: Use the Chrome omnibox (fastest)
1. Focus the Chrome address/search bar (the omnibox) at the top of the window. You can click it with the mouse or press Ctrl+L.
2. Type one of these queries and press Enter:
   - weather Shanghai
   - Shanghai weather
3. Read the Google weather card that appears at the top of the search results. What to look for:
   - Large current temperature and condition icon (e.g., sun, cloud, moon).
   - Short text summary (e.g., Clear, Light rain).
   - Additional lines for precipitation chance, humidity, wind, and a short forecast.
4. For more detail from the card:
   - Click any link shown on the card (e.g., hourly forecast or the source link) to open a fuller forecast page.
   - Use the °C/°F toggle if present to switch units.

Method B — Detailed: Open a trusted weather site (AccuWeather example)
1. Open the AccuWeather Shanghai page in Chrome. You can click a Google search result or open the URL directly in the omnibox:
   - https://accuweather.com/en/cn/shanghai/106577/weather-forecast/106577
2. On the AccuWeather page, locate these UI elements:
   - Top search box / "Location" dropdown (top-right) — to change to another city if needed.
   - Navigation tabs under the header: TODAY | HOURLY | DAILY | RADAR | MINUTECAST (use these to jump to hourly or radar views).
   - CURRENT WEATHER card (mid-page) — large temperature and icon on the left, details column on the right (Wind, Wind Gusts, Air Quality).
   - "MORE DETAILS" link (below the condition summary) — click to open expanded data like humidity, pressure, visibility, and detailed hourly conditions.
3. Read the current temperature and condition icon (left side) and check the right column for wind speed/direction and air quality.
4. For additional views:
   - Click HOURLY for hour-by-hour forecasts.
   - Click DAILY for an extended multi-day forecast.
   - Click RADAR to view precipitation maps (if available for the region).

Tips & Visual Cues
- The omnibox/Google card is the fastest method for a quick glance; it appears at the top of search results after typing "weather Shanghai".
- AccuWeather's CURRENT WEATHER card displays a very large numeric temperature on the left and a small details column on the right — use the "MORE DETAILS" link for expanded observations.
- If you need a persistent quick-access display, consider adding a weather extension from the Chrome Web Store (not covered here).

This tutorial was prepared from a live Chrome session on the AccuWeather Shanghai page and verified by observing the Google search results and AccuWeather current-weather card.")
